about.title: About
about.lead: One foot in creativity, one foot in analysis.
bio: My name is Anaïs. I am studying for a **Master’s in Innovation Management at Université Paris-Dauphine – PSL**, currently on a gap year, and I run my own micro-business in communication consulting and web development.

With **4 years of combined experience** and **more than 10 projects delivered**, my focus remains the same: taking an idea from paper to market. I launched Afro Buffet, a board game brand about African cuisine, from concept to a 1,000-unit production run. Since 2022, I have run the social media strategy of a US multinational in the Republic of the Congo every season. Along the way, I have built financial dashboards, launch strategies, web apps and a crisis recovery plan.

I like to understand the real problem before acting, then deliver fast and clean, using AI when it saves time without sacrificing quality. Based in Paris, I work with France, Africa and the wider world.
**I am open to an internship starting January 2027** and available year-round for consulting assignments.
